Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that The Man in the High Castle was authored by Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson, leading to the wrong conclusion that Ray Nelson was the common author. In reality, The Man in the High Castle was written solely by Philip K. Dick, while The Ganymede Takeover was co-authored by Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson.
